heading: Questions, *answered.*

items.question: When are Christmas Eve services at Christ Community Church?
items.answer: Wednesday, December 23, at 6:00 PM, and Christmas Eve, Thursday, December 24, at 2:00, 4:00, and 6:00 PM. Every service is the same one-hour experience, and all times are in CST.

items.question: Where is Christ Community Church?
items.answer: 404 S 108th Ave, Omaha, NE 68154. We're located in West Omaha, an easy drive from Millard, Elkhorn, Ralston, La Vista, Papillion, Bellevue, and Council Bluffs.

items.question: Do I need tickets?
items.answer: No. Services are free and open to everyone. Pick a time and come. Worship Center doors open thirty minutes before each service, and seats are first come, first served.

items.question: Is there childcare?
items.answer: Yes, for kids 3 and under at the Wednesday 6:00 PM and Thursday 4:00 PM services. Kids of all ages are welcome at every service, and the Wiggle Room in the Atrium streams the service live for little ones who need to move.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Whatever you're comfortable in. You'll see Christmas sweaters, dresses, suits, and jeans.

items.question: Is there an ASL interpreted service?
items.answer: Yes. The 6:00 PM service on Wednesday, December 23, is ASL interpreted and live-captioned on-site.

items.question: Can I watch Christmas Eve services online?
items.answer: Yes. Every service on December 23 and 24 streams live on YouTube and the CCC app and is available for on-demand viewing afterward.

items.question: How long is the service?
items.answer: About one hour, with carols, candlelight, something for every age, and the story of the birth of Jesus.
